archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Cyberpunk 2077 update; Katana ZERO DLC expands

entries.headline: Cyberpunk 2077 launches a free Edgerunners 2 update with a prequel quest and dual wielding
entries.summary: CD PROJEKT RED has released the free Edgerunners 2 Update. Its new quest sends V to help Weak Kingsley at Night City Prison and serves as a prequel to the anime’s second season; the update also adds Weak’s gear, the HKGN 102.FM station, dual wielding, and more customization.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire primary report confirms that the free update is available now and details the new quest, Night City Prison, Weak Kingsley, HKGN 102.FM, and dual wielding.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE arrives on Xbox as an HD-2D reworking of Brave Exvius
entries.summary: Square Enix and LANCARSE rebuilt the story of FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS as a single-player, single-purchase RPG with HD-2D presentation. Xbox Wire confirms it is available now on Xbox.
entries.verification: The Xbox Wire primary report confirms the game is available on Xbox and identifies its HD-2D presentation, adaptation of Brave Exvius, and single-player, single-purchase format.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: Katana ZERO DLC grows to “full sequel” size with more than 30 new tracks
entries.summary: Developer Askiisoft says the DLC remains in production, has grown to the size of a full sequel, and will include a soundtrack with more than 30 new songs. No release date was announced.
entries.verification: Gematsu and Denfaminicogamer independently relay the same public Askiisoft update, agreeing on the sequel-sized scope and more than 30 new tracks.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: The Blood of Dawnwalker Update 1.1 improves performance and restores gore in the Japanese Steam version
entries.summary: Rebel Wolves has released the game’s first major update, adding performance and stability work, combat and camera improvements, skill respec, and a new difficulty option. The Japanese Steam version also restores previously restricted blood and gore.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer and Game Informer reports both confirm Update 1.1; 4Gamer verifies the Japanese-version content change, while Game Informer details performance, combat, and quality-of-life improvements.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: Hono Gurashi no Niwa’s second free update lands October 27
entries.summary: Nippon Ichi Software says the update adds a protagonist birthday event, the Seeder tool, ten bathroom furniture items, and multiple feature improvements.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer and Denfaminicogamer reports consistently relay Nippon Ichi Software’s announcement, including the date and principal additions.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: Super Danganronpa 2×2 lowers its PC system requirements
entries.summary: Spike Chunsoft has revised the PC requirements after criticism that the original targets were unusually high. The remake is due January 14, 2027 for Steam, Epic, Switch 2, Switch, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly cites Spike Chunsoft’s same-day announcement and confirms the revised PC requirements, release platforms, and date.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: Game Boy Nintendo Classics adds three more games
entries.summary: Nintendo has added Moguranya, Pinball: 66 Crocodiles on the Move, and Phantasm to Game Boy Nintendo Classics for Nintendo Switch Online members on Switch and Switch 2.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report clearly relays Nintendo’s same-day release information and lists all three games and supported systems.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: Phantom Blade Zero gets a launch trailer; PS5 physical editions follow in 2027
entries.summary: S-GAME released the launch trailer and confirmed Standard, Deluxe, and Ultimate physical editions for PlayStation 5 in 2027. The game uses Unreal Engine 5 and features more than 30 weapons and over 20 Phantom Edges.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays S-GAME’s announcement, confirming the launch trailer and three planned PS5 physical editions for 2027.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: Co-op comedy horror game QUIET launches a demo on Steam and Epic
entries.summary: LINE Games has released a PC demo through Steam and the Epic Games Store. Players control duck-like aliens trying to escape their landlady after crash-landing on Earth.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report clearly relays LINE Games’ release information, confirming the demo platforms and core premise.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: Wall World Strategy launches November 11 with colony-management gameplay
entries.summary: Alawar set a November 11 release date for the Wall World spin-off, which shifts the series toward colony management while retaining its signature multi-legged mech.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report clearly relays publisher Alawar’s release-date announcement and the game’s colony-management focus.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: League of Legends allows up to 10 replay downloads per hour
entries.summary: Riot Games revised its disputed replay policy in Patch 26.21: players can still download other players’ match replays, with a limit of ten per hour. The patch also includes champion balance changes and True Damage-themed content.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report clearly relays Riot Games’ Patch 26.21 change, including the hourly replay-download allowance and patch version.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: ANOMALITH composer Yuka Kitamura explains the sound of an everyday world turning strange
entries.summary: In an original interview, lead composer Yuka Kitamura describes using familiar, everyday timbres to express the game’s blend of Showa-era retro aesthetics, liminal spaces, and anomalies. The game is due October 29 for PS5, Switch 2, and Steam.
entries.verification: The opened original AUTOMATON email interview identifies the interviewee and clearly supports the creative approach, platforms, and release date.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: ACE COMBAT ZERO becomes a standalone Steam app for preorder owners
entries.summary: Bandai Namco now lets ACE COMBAT 8 preorder customers download and launch ACE COMBAT ZERO as a separate 3.2GB app, removing the need to install the 140GB main game. It can still be launched from ACE COMBAT 8.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report verifies the revised standalone store app and release details, including its size and eligible customers.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.

entries.headline: Luma Island comes to PS5 and Xbox Series on December 2 with four-player cross-platform multiplayer
entries.summary: Feel Free Games says Luma Island will launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series on December 2 for $19.99. The console release adds full cross-platform multiplayer for up to four players across PS5, Xbox Series, and PC.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays Feel Free Games’ announcement, confirming the December 2 console date, $19.99 price, and four-player cross-platform multiplayer.
entries.timeNote: The evidence supports only the date or window placement; no undisclosed exact time was inferred.
